title: How AI Is Changing the Pace of Discovery for Millions Living With Dementia
script:
Fifty-seven million people worldwide currently live with dementia.
Researchers at the C-BRAIN consortium are struggling with an explosion of medical data.
Dr. Randall Bateman leads this group using AI to bridge the research gap.
They use high-performance computing to synthesize massive datasets that were previously unmanageable.
This allows labs to process complex brain images much faster than manual human review.
C-BRAIN makes these AI tools open-source to help labs everywhere accelerate their findings.
Do you think open-source AI will finally break the barrier to new treatments?

editor.one_line: Strong reporting, but visuals are repetitive and rely too heavily on generic stock imagery.
script_fixes: LINE 2: Change 'struggling with an explosion of medical data' to 'struggling to synthesize petabytes of medical data'.
visual_notes: line 2: The C-BRAIN data challenge graphic is held for too long across three frames.
line 4: The stock footage of a man at a computer is generic and does not represent C-BRAIN.
line 6: The NVIDIA Blog logo is used as a placeholder; it is not the C-BRAIN tool.
